verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Figma Make using designs, web content and MCP-connected data only as context for generating apps and prototypes. It also creates an editable plan before generation. None of this is a documented feature that analyzes the user's own data and returns AI-generated insights or suggestions; these are adjacent generation features, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
